# Chapter 2

Date: 2026-02-01

## Scenes

### 002.01 Out of the Pens

The party slipped out of the pens. Jimjar led them through the dark while Eldeth watched the rear, and the GM described the drip of water on stone.

#### Jimjar guides the party out of the pens.

- Jimjar picks the lock and leads the way.

### 002.02 A Quiet Count

The party counted their supplies and rested. Nobody spoke of the guards.

#### The party rests.

- The party takes stock.

## Memorable Moments

> "Keep your voices down, the walls listen."
> — Jimjar
> *Whispered at the mouth of the tunnel, with a glance back toward the pens.*

> "We share the water, or nobody drinks."
> — Daz
> *Said flatly, to settle an argument over the last skin.*

**Eldeth takes the rear.**

*She would not be argued with.*
